Majority of the reception staff are rude and obnoxious with a horrible snooty attitude. The odds of seeing an actual Dr are slim. Usually you're fobbed off with a Physician Associate (these people are NOT Drs and don't let them tell you otherwise, two years of training a GP does not make) who have a habit of misdiagnosis. Or you'll see a Paramedic...I've got a lot of time for Paramedics, but they also aren't GPs. You'll also never sse the same Dr, I'm not even sure they have regular GPs here, suspect it's one of those surgeries that's trying to do away with them.

The online Triage system, Patches, is a joke.

This place has been terrible for years, had a recent mild but persistent ear problem. Fobbed off with endless checks for my BP...yes it's elevated, I've just raced here from work and ran up a hill, but they wouldn't listen, just wanted me out of the door asap. Didn't really check the actual area that was causing me issues (ear) but kept on about blood pressure, I left more than once questioning my own sanity.
